narrative.overview: A course is a metro line and each lesson a station on it. A learner reads the course the way a commuter reads a line map: where they are, where they last got off, which stops are optional, and the next stop, all at a glance. The world lends the product four things only: a station-wall light ground with deep navy signage bands, one saturated line colour per course, tabular station numbers in rings, and the route line itself. Navigation, controls and dialogs stay standard.
keyCharacteristics: Light station-wall ground, navy signage band on every screen (50px catalog, 42px lesson).
One line colour per course, carried by the band's underline, route line, rings and primary actions.
Route line through compact station rows; next station panel above the list.
Dark code wells for editor, terminal, answers and results.
Shape-coded state; amber admin, violet narration.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: A screen shows one course line colour, and only on the route, rings, the band underline and primary actions; never as decoration.

rules.name: The Voices Rule
rules.body: Violet speaks for the narrator and amber for the admin; neither colour is used for anything else.

rules.name: The Numbers Rule
rules.body: Station numbers and progress counts use tabular figures so a column of rows reads as a timetable.

rules.name: The Flat Wall Rule
rules.body: Nothing resting on the page casts a shadow; only menus, dialogs and the narrator's caption float.

rules.name: The Same Station Rule
rules.body: Light and dark are one world: every role keeps its job, only the lighting changes; nothing is inverted with a filter.

dos: Do derive every station state from recorded progress only, and show unknown (dashed ring, 진도를 확인하고 있어요) instead of a guess.
Do keep the editor, terminal, answers and results inside the dark well.
Do keep the lesson band at 42px and the catalog band at 50px on windows 700px and wider.
Do give every icon-only control its full Korean name as its accessible name.
Do define every colour as a role token with a value for each look; a literal colour that only works on one ground is a bug.
donts: Don't use the line colour, violet or amber for decoration.
Don't add side stripes thicker than 1px to callouts, rows or alerts; asides are paper-inset panels with a 1px rule.
Don't draw a second filled primary action in the station list.
Don't add entrance animation; motion is limited to 160ms colour and dot-scale changes, removed under reduced motion.
